caseNameFull: Adams Express Company v. W. N. Reynolds
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of North Carolina.
attorneys: Mr. William A. Schnader, with whom Mr. Thomas DeWitt Cuyler was on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Mr. B. S. Womble and Mr. W. M. Hendren, with whom Mr. Clement Manly was on the brief, for defendant, in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of § 237 of the Judicial Code, as amended by the Act of September 6, 1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726.
